notes.title: Version 2.27.2000
notes.notes:
* New round of Skins.
* GOD Attribute: visible in stat panel.
* Dungeon / PvP Zone: Now teams are balance with the GOD attribute of the team.
* Increase the beneficts of Drop Rate, XP Rate, Magic Rate of the mobs in this zones. Also increase Health Points and Armor of mobs.
* Remove count of mobs of all zones, especially the pacific zones.
* Separate the XP required for level up in tiers.
* Notify count of groups in differentes arena types.
